text: 金十数据10月10日讯，商务部等7部门发布关于实施品质电商“五优”行动的通知，通知指出，推动平台规则向优转型。督促电商平台依法依规开展平台规则制定和修改，全面落实平台规则公示、公开征求意见等要求。指导电商平台规范规则执行行为，保护平台内商家、消费者合法权益。推动电商平台持续优化商品展示、推荐和营销活动机制，强化商品质量、服务口碑、信用信息等品质导向，促进品质商品和服务更好触达消费者。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 - The Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued a notice on implementing the "Five Excellences" action for quality e-commerce. The notice pointed out that platform rules should be promoted toward optimal transformation. Urge e-commerce platforms to formulate and revise platform rules in accordance with laws and regulations, and fully implement requirements such as public disclosure of platform rules and public solicitation of opinions. Guide e-commerce platforms to standardize rule enforcement behavior and protect the lawful rights and interests of merchants and consumers on the platform. Promote e-commerce platforms to continuously optimize mechanisms for product display, recommendation, and marketing activities, strengthen quality orientation such as product quality, service reputation, and credit information, and promote better reach of quality goods and services to consumers.
